title: Effective full-isotropy constraints for time-space-label symmetries
exact_target: Determine the time, space and label symmetry groups realizable by n-body solutions.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002542 (AIM-PHYSICS-0050). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Variational Methods in Celestial Mechanics; notes by Kuo-Chang Chen, version 22 June 2003, source item 13.

status_qualification: Realization as a contained symmetry group and realization as the full stabilizer are different; the original question does not explicitly choose one. The classification and multiplicity-of-realization request must both be addressed without inventing that choice. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
